title: FreeCAD effective import options and text-scale calibration
mode: Primary-source web research and plan-only consumer-gate refinement
scope: Refresh the existing native FreeCAD DXF consumer lane against current source, API, documentation, and a current confirmed issue.
Determine whether requested importer options alone are sufficient evidence for text-property parity.
Add a fast, implementation-ready calibration at the existing composed native checkpoint without expanding routine test frequency.

sources.revision: Mutable main branch reviewed 2026-10-20; no immutable source commit resolved
sources.observed: The direct binding accepts a filename and optional document name, ignore_errors Boolean, and option_source string. Source defaults ignore_errors to true, constructs the C++ DXF reader, supplies options, reads and recomputes the document, and returns importer statistics.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Source/API inspection, not an executed result from an installed FreeCAD build. The GUI/Open/Insert route may have different error handling and must be recorded separately.

sources.revision: Mutable main branch reviewed 2026-10-20; no immutable source commit resolved
sources.observed: The C++ reader uses an explicit option-source path and records import settings, including text/dimension import, manual scaling, layouts, hidden blocks, layers, and colors, in its statistics structure.
sources.evidenceCeiling: The returned/requested configuration improves run reproducibility but cannot establish correctness of imported text properties; capture the resulting document object's actual values.

sources.observed: The issue remains open and carries a confirmed label. The reporter describes C++ DXF import applying the Draft Scale Multiplier to file-authored TEXT height on FreeCAD 1.1.1 and a 1.2 development build, and expects the TEXT height from DXF to remain unchanged.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Confirmed peer report only; not reproduced in this worktree, not a normative DXF rule, and not evidence of a libdxfrw defect. The issue attachment was not downloaded.

sources.observed: The docs describe distinct C++ and legacy Python DXF importers with different feature profiles and state that stock FreeCAD does not read embedded ACIS/SAT solids.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Documentation bounds candidate routes; it is not a pinned runtime qualification and provides no ACIS/B-rep semantic evidence.

existingSubplansRefined: PAR-07/S8: native FreeCAD qualification should capture requested and effective importer settings, returned statistics, and resulting object properties; add a generated known-height TEXT calibration only when text is in the declared consumer profile.
assessment.planImpact: At the existing composed native FreeCAD checkpoint, pin the application/backend/error policy/option source; record requested preferences and returned statistics when available; and inspect the imported TEXT height and placement against an independent source manifest. Treat a mismatch confined to the consumer importer as a consumer limitation, not a libdxfrw failure. Keep the legacy Python importer separate and keep all ACIS/AcDs semantic gates unchanged.

method.kind: Read-only primary-source documentation, source, and issue review; local plan-only update
method.limitations: FreeCAD source, issue state, and documentation are mutable and were not pinned to an immutable commit or executed here. The issue report motivates a calibration but does not prove behavior on every current build or profile.
